evals.name: kt-shopify-amps
evals.prompt: Pull the specs for all the amplifiers at https://www.kt-audio.com/collections/amplifiers — I need channel count, power at each impedance, and minimum load impedance for each one, as a JSON file I can import into my planning tool.
evals.expected_output: JSON with all 4 KT amps (MX3-700, MX3-200, Dynamiq 750, Dynamiq 450), power keyed by impedance, verified flags

evals.name: xta-power-matrix
evals.prompt: Get me the full power table for the XTA DNA and DPA amplifier range from https://xta.co.uk/portfolio/delta-dpa-dna-legacy/ — I specifically need what each model does at 8, 4, 2.7 and 2 ohms because I'm working out how many speakers I can hang off each channel.
evals.expected_output: All 9 models with complete 4-impedance power matrix, min_ohm=2, bridge figures

evals.name: image-pdf-extraction
evals.prompt: This SAE datasheet is a scanned PDF with no text in it. Get the power specs for both amplifier models out of it and give me a JSON summary.
evals.expected_output: PQM8 and PQM13 with 8/4/2 ohm stereo + 8/4 ohm bridge figures extracted from page images
